# Prism

Prebuilt files copied unmodified from the npm package `prismjs` at version `1.30.0`, whose tarball matched the registry integrity `sha512-DEvV2ZF2r2/63V+tK8hQvrR2ZGn10srHbXviTlcv7Kpzw8jWiNTqbVgjO3IY8RxrrOUF8VPMQQFysYYYv0YZxw==`.
